text: The Collective Agreement between the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and the Canadian Union of Public Employees, Local 2840 (CUPE 2840) expired on December 31, 2021. This report outlines the terms of a Memorandum of Agreement attached as Confidential Attachment 1 - Appendix A, that was ratified by CUPE 2840 members on March 20, 2022, and pending Board approval would be the basis of a Collective Agreement with the Board, with an expiry date of December 31, 2024. The bargaining process was positive with the key principles of transparency, focus on sustainability of Exhibition Place businesses, quality assurance and the highest level of customer service the priority.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the terms and conditions of the Memorandum of Agreement, as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 1 - Appendix A to the report (May 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, between the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and Canadian Union of Public Employees, Local 2840. 2. Authorized staff to make the necessary amendments to rates of pay and other issues identified as agreed changes to the collective agreement in the Memorandum of Agreement as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place. 3.
